params.body:
Follow-up to #418 (the agreement print). Shane: "scherm aanmaak borderel is ook niet ideaal". At 1440 the "Maak borderel" dialog took the theme's `full-modal` width (a 1500px sheet): three full-width inputs with the value far right, seven checkbox rows with the box at the far end of a hairline, a 300px textarea and the button in a footer below the fold.

**What changed** (`resources/views/export/showBorderelModal.blade.php`, `resources/css/refresh.css`):

- The dialog is 640px wide (`#borderel-modal .modal-dialog`), same card treatment as the merchant modal.
- Overnameprijs, Huidige kilometerstand and Aantal sleutels share one row (`ui-form-grid ui-form-grid--3 ui-form-grid--numbers`), each with its unit in front (€, km, key icon) and tabular figures; on a phone they stack.
- The seven documents are a two-column checklist (`ui-check-grid`) of `x-ui.checkbox` rows: box left of its label, label and box one target, 44px rows, no hairlines; one column on a phone. Group label reuses `borderel.documents_recieved`.
- Omschrijving is an auto-growing textarea (min 4 rows, the existing `autogrow` of `x-ui.textarea`).
- The action sits in `ui-form-actions` at the end of the form; the `modal-footer` is gone.

No field names, values or controller changes: the form posts `takeover_price`, `actual_millage`, `keys`, `check[...]` and `description` exactly as before (`BorderelFormTest`, `@rule B1-6.2`).

**Screenshots** (worktree `.playwright-mcp/agreement-borderel/`): `borderel-1440-before.png`, `borderel-1440-after.png`, `borderel-390-before.png`, `borderel-390-after.png`.

Filter run: `Agreement|Borderel|Export|Bidding|Option|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: OK (102 tests, 999 assertions).
params.title: The borderel form reads as a form
